verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents a Case API for creating or updating cases and APIs for listing and fetching cases explicitly "for information retrieval or data syncing", plus a batch case import API. Together these give a developer the core building blocks to sync cases with another system in both directions. However, the developer docs are fully password-gated, so the depth of the sync cannot be verified, and nothing shows that decisions or dispositions specifically are exposed. missing for 10: documented sync of decisions/dispositions, change notifications or webhooks for ongoing sync, a public API reference/spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system

citations.quote: for information retrieval or data syncing, Hummingbird provides APIs for listing cases and fetching case information over API.
Hummingbird provides a Case API for creating or updating cases.
Hummingbird also supports batch creating cases over the case import API.
